opening_01.speaker: narrator
opening_01.text: Once, men begged the gods to spare them from death.

opening_03.speaker: narrator
opening_03.text: They built bodies that could not grow old. Thrones that could not be inherited. Kingdoms that could not escape them.

opening_04.speaker: narrator
opening_04.text: But even eternity could not protect them from the people they ruled.

opening_05.speaker: narrator
opening_05.text: The crowns shattered. Their kingdoms fell. And for three hundred years, humanity believed itself free.

awakening_03.speaker: lyra
awakening_03.text: Someone who has been waiting a very long time.

awakening_05.speaker: lyra
awakening_05.text: That depends. What do you remember?

awakening_06.speaker: player
awakening_06.text: Things I couldn't possibly have seen.

first_road_01.speaker: lyra
first_road_01.text: The doors above you open onto what was a fortress. Walk. Your body remembers how, even if you don't.

first_road_02.speaker: lyra
first_road_02.text: Tap where you want to go. If something stands in the way, it has been standing there a long time.

courtyard_0_01.speaker: lyra
courtyard_0_01.text: Those statues were kings once. People prayed to them. Some of them answered.

courtyard_1_01.speaker: lyra
courtyard_1_01.text: Look at its armour. Under the plate there is light. That is not rust moving it.

courtyard_2_01.speaker: lyra
courtyard_2_01.text: It salutes before it strikes. Someone taught it manners, three hundred years ago.

courtyard_3_01.speaker: lyra
courtyard_3_01.text: That winch will hold. Most things they built still do. That is rather the problem.

courtyard_4_01.speaker: lyra
courtyard_4_01.text: Careful. The big ones were made for breaking gates. You are much smaller than a gate.

courtyard_5_01.speaker: lyra
courtyard_5_01.text: Rest. That candle is not a candle, but it will not hurt you.

courtyard_6_01.speaker: lyra
courtyard_6_01.text: He is still at his post. He has not been told that there is nothing left behind him.

gen1_open_01.speaker: narrator
gen1_open_01.text: For centuries the bells of Vaelora rang beneath the same sovereign.

gen1_open_02.speaker: narrator
gen1_open_02.text: Harvests failed and were mended. Villages fell silent and were forgotten. Upon the throne, nothing changed.

gen1_open_03.speaker: narrator
gen1_open_03.text: One warden of the low road dared to ask what such permanence had cost.

gen1_throne_01.speaker: forebear
gen1_throne_01.text: Three villages have fallen silent. Their names are struck from your records.

gen1_throne_02.speaker: monarch
gen1_throne_02.text: Their silence has bought another winter for thousands.

gen1_throne_03.speaker: forebear
gen1_throne_03.text: You speak of people as though they were coin.

gen1_throne_04.speaker: monarch
gen1_throne_04.text: A ruler must count what others refuse to count.

gen1_guard_01.speaker: monarch
gen1_guard_01.text: Show the warden to the gate.

gen1_records_01.speaker: forebear
gen1_records_01.text: The count is behind that seal. I did not climb this far to be told the sum.

gen1_seal_02.speaker: monarch
gen1_seal_02.text: You have done nothing but leave this burden to another.

gen1_seal_03.speaker: forebear
gen1_seal_03.text: Then another will come better prepared.

gen1_close_m_01.speaker: narrator
gen1_close_m_01.text: His name disappeared from the royal histories.

gen1_close_m_02.speaker: narrator
gen1_close_m_02.text: But not from those of his house.

gen1_close_f_01.speaker: narrator
gen1_close_f_01.text: Her name disappeared from the royal histories.

gen1_close_f_02.speaker: narrator
gen1_close_f_02.text: But not from those of her house.

gen2_arrive_m_01.speaker: player
gen2_arrive_m_01.text: I know where you died, Father. I would know why.

gen2_arrive_f_01.speaker: player
gen2_arrive_f_01.text: I know where you died, Mother. I would know why.

monarch_blade_01.speaker: monarch
monarch_blade_01.text: That blade. I had wondered when I would see it again.
monarch_blade_01.dir: quiet, to the sword, not to its bearer

gen2_seal_burns_01.speaker: lyra
gen2_seal_burns_01.text: The seal behind the throne is burning. What the first of your house could not carry out is still in it.

monarch_restored_01.speaker: monarch
monarch_restored_01.text: You see the difficulty. I am not the thing that is keeping me.

gen2_seal_01.speaker: player
gen2_seal_01.text: All these years I thought I had come for your life.
gen2_seal_01.dir: at the seal, back to him

gen2_seal_02.speaker: monarch
gen2_seal_02.text: And what have you found instead?

gen2_seal_03.speaker: player
gen2_seal_03.text: The means to end your reign.

gen2_close_01.speaker: narrator
gen2_close_01.text: The second of that house fell beneath the same throne.

gen2_close_02.speaker: narrator
gen2_close_02.text: But where the first had left a question, this one left an answer.

gen3_arrive_01.speaker: lyra
gen3_arrive_01.text: Three of your house have stood before those gates.

gen3_engine_01.speaker: lyra
gen3_engine_01.text: I kept all of it. I could not keep them.

kept_approach_01.speaker: witness
kept_approach_01.text: Stop. Do not go in yet.

kept_approach_03.speaker: witness
kept_approach_03.text: It is the walk. I kept station at that shoulder for a year.

kept_intro_01.speaker: kept
kept_intro_01.text: State your... no. That was his question.
kept_intro_01.dir: a closed helm; a voice the player knows, slowed

kept_intro_03.speaker: kept
kept_intro_03.dir: as if reading it off something

kept_beat_01.speaker: kept
kept_beat_01.text: You stand the way I stood.

kept_beat_02.speaker: player
kept_beat_02.text: Someone taught me how you stood.

kept_after_01.speaker: kept
kept_after_01.text: You kept the edge on it.

kept_after_02.speaker: kept
kept_after_02.text: Go on. I have held this gate as long as I was able.

kept_after_03.speaker: witness
kept_after_03.text: I will set that down as it happened. All of it. Both times.

monarch_g3_intro_01.speaker: monarch
monarch_g3_intro_01.text: Your family has spent two lifetimes at my gates.

monarch_g3_intro_02.speaker: player
monarch_g3_intro_02.text: Three. You are keeping one of them.

monarch_g3_intro_03.speaker: monarch
monarch_g3_intro_03.text: I keep everything. It is the whole of my office.

monarch_g3_intro_04.speaker: player
monarch_g3_intro_04.text: And you have mistaken survival for the right to rule.

monarch_g3_intro_05.speaker: monarch
monarch_g3_intro_05.text: When these machines fall silent, they will remember whom to blame.

monarch_g3_intro_06.speaker: player
monarch_g3_intro_06.text: Then let them remember a choice was made.

final_door_01.speaker: witness
final_door_01.text: There is a door. Not from this side of the wall.

facility_01.speaker: lyra
facility_01.text: This was never merely a kingdom.

facility_03.speaker: lyra
facility_03.text: A means of keeping one alive.

courtyard_0_g3_01.speaker: lyra
courtyard_0_g3_01.text: The plate on these is new. He has been replacing what your house broke.

blackwood_0_g3_01.speaker: witness
blackwood_0_g3_01.text: The lanterns were lit when I last came this way. I was at another shoulder.

cathedral_0_g3_01.speaker: lyra
cathedral_0_g3_01.text: The door under the crossing was on no plan I was given. Neither was I.

citadel_0_g3_01.speaker: witness
citadel_0_g3_01.text: A king who gave up his crown, and the hall is still kept. Habit outlives everything.

throne_0_g3_01.speaker: lyra
throne_0_g3_01.text: Twice this door has opened for your house. Nobody came back through it.

deep_0_g3_01.speaker: lyra
deep_0_g3_01.text: Everything he kept is under here. So am I.

sentinel_death_03.speaker: sentinel
sentinel_death_03.text: Then why did no one return for me?

sentinel_memory_01.speaker: archivist
sentinel_memory_01.text: Record incomplete. Witness deceased. Memory retained.

sentinel_memory_02.speaker: archivist
sentinel_memory_02.text: Subject: gate sergeant, forty-one years of service. Volunteered. He was told it would be for one winter.

sentinel_memory_03.speaker: lyra
sentinel_memory_03.text: They were people. All of them. Remember that when the next one raises its sword.

sanctuary_return_01.speaker: lyra
sanctuary_return_01.text: You came back by the door this time. I prefer it.

sanctuary_return_02.speaker: lyra
sanctuary_return_02.text: There is a smith here. He does not trust you. He is very good. Let him look at that sword.

orren_intro_01.speaker: orren
orren_intro_01.text: So you're what she woke up. Hm.

orren_intro_02.speaker: orren
orren_intro_02.text: That sword is older than my entire bloodline. Try not to drop it.

orren_intro_03.speaker: orren
orren_intro_03.text: Bring me shards and coin. Your armour remembers its shape. I just remind it.

orren_idle_01.speaker: orren
orren_idle_01.text: People spend their lives searching for legendary weapons. Most of them wouldn't know what to do with one.

rebirth_0_01.speaker: lyra
rebirth_0_01.text: You returned sooner than I expected.

rebirth_1_01.speaker: lyra
rebirth_1_01.text: Your body has recovered. Your memories are another matter.

rebirth_2_01.speaker: lyra
rebirth_2_01.text: You remembered something this time, didn't you?

rebirth_3_01.speaker: lyra
rebirth_3_01.text: The system is learning from you.

rebirth_4_01.speaker: lyra
rebirth_4_01.text: You're becoming someone it cannot predict.

rebirth_5_01.speaker: lyra
rebirth_5_01.text: Those memories aren't orders. You don't owe the dead your future.

executioner_intro_03.speaker: executioner
executioner_intro_03.text: The law does not require a kingdom.

executioner_death_01.speaker: lyra
executioner_death_01.text: That prison was switched back on from somewhere else. Someone is waking them. On purpose.

huntsman_intro_01.speaker: huntsman
huntsman_intro_01.text: I have hunted what the old kings bred. I know one of their things when I see it.

widow_intro_01.speaker: widow
widow_intro_01.text: That stance. I knew the soldier who taught it.

widow_intro_03.speaker: widow
widow_intro_03.text: No. But someone inside you has.

widow_death_01.speaker: widow
widow_death_01.text: You fight like six people I buried. And none of them.

beast_intro_01.speaker: lyra
beast_intro_01.text: That was grown, not born. Do not look for a man inside it.

gravewarden_intro_03.speaker: gravewarden
gravewarden_intro_03.text: People waiting for someone to remember their names.

gravewarden_death_01.speaker: archivist
gravewarden_death_01.text: You are not the first to enter this chamber. You are merely the first it has permitted to leave.

gravewarden_death_02.speaker: archivist
gravewarden_death_02.text: History has been rewritten seventeen times. Would you prefer the surviving version?

frostking_intro_01.speaker: frostking
frostking_intro_01.text: I watched men become gods. Then I watched gods become machines.

frostking_intro_02.speaker: player
frostking_intro_02.text: Why didn't you destroy the Crown?

frostking_intro_03.speaker: frostking
frostking_intro_03.text: Because there were still people inside it.

frostking_retry_01.speaker: frostking
frostking_retry_01.text: Every resurrection makes the chains harder to break.

frostking_death_01.speaker: frostking
frostking_death_01.text: Go to the capital. Do better than we did. It will not be difficult.

wyrm_intro_01.speaker: lyra
wyrm_intro_01.text: They built her to break sieges. She has had centuries to decide what else she is.

devourer_intro_01.speaker: devourer
devourer_intro_01.dir: a man, lost, under other voices

devourer_death_04.speaker: player
devourer_death_04.text: I don't know them. I'm sorry.

monarch_intro_01.speaker: monarch
monarch_intro_01.text: Look upon what remains of our civilization.

monarch_intro_02.speaker: player
monarch_intro_02.text: I see a kingdom that should have been allowed to die.

monarch_intro_03.speaker: monarch
monarch_intro_03.text: And I see children who will never wake if these machines fall silent.

monarch_intro_04.speaker: player
monarch_intro_04.text: How many people have you sacrificed?

monarch_intro_05.speaker: monarch
monarch_intro_05.text: Enough to ensure there are still people left to ask that question.

monarch_retry_01.speaker: monarch
monarch_retry_01.text: You still believe death cannot teach you surrender.

monarch_death_01.speaker: monarch
monarch_death_01.text: I have counted every life this machine has taken. Have you counted the lives it has saved?

monarch_death_02.speaker: lyra
monarch_death_02.text: I think I remember the rain.

witness_discovery_01.speaker: lyra
witness_discovery_01.text: Wait. Under the fallen plinth. There is a door there that is on no plan I hold.

witness_discovery_02.speaker: witness
witness_discovery_02.text: Ah. At last. I had begun to suspect the dead were better company.

witness_discovery_04.speaker: witness
witness_discovery_04.text: A witness to rather more than I would care to remember.

witness_discovery_05.speaker: witness
witness_discovery_05.text: And to rather less than I ought. They took a good deal out of me before they shut that door.

witness_discovery_07.speaker: witness
witness_discovery_07.text: If I knew that, I should be a happier ornament. Lift me down. I weigh very little, and I know this road.

witness_discovery_08.speaker: lyra
witness_discovery_08.text: I do not know what that is. I do not like not knowing.

witness_discovery_09.speaker: witness
witness_discovery_09.text: The voice in the walls disapproves of me. Good. We shall get on.

w_courtyard_approach_01.speaker: witness
w_courtyard_approach_01.text: So this is what became of the outer court. It had a grander name when it stood. I forget it. Mercifully.

w_courtyard_gate_01.speaker: witness
w_courtyard_gate_01.text: That gate once bore the banners of thirteen kings. Now look at it. Eternity has a peculiar sense of humour.

w_courtyard_passage_01.speaker: witness
w_courtyard_passage_01.text: They built the passage narrow so that one man could hold it. Nobody asked which man.

w_courtyard_candle_01.speaker: witness
w_courtyard_candle_01.text: A candle three hundred years alight. In my day we called that a miracle. We were paid to.

w_sentinel_approach_01.speaker: witness
w_sentinel_approach_01.text: He will ask your allegiance. There is no right answer. There never was one.

w_sentinel_approach_02.speaker: player
w_sentinel_approach_02.text: Then he will have the true one.

w_sentinel_victory_01.speaker: witness
w_sentinel_victory_01.text: One winter, they told him. I believe I wrote that order down. I hope I argued.

w_blackwood_approach_01.speaker: witness
w_blackwood_approach_01.text: The Blackwood. The lanterns are still lit. Somebody is paying the lamplighter, and I should like to know in what coin.

w_blackwood_briars_01.speaker: witness
w_blackwood_briars_01.text: Woven. Thorn does not plait itself. Somebody here still keeps a boundary.

w_blackwood_bridge_01.speaker: witness
w_blackwood_bridge_01.text: There was a toll on this crossing, and a clerk. He counted heads going in. He did not count them coming out.

w_blackwood_gibbet_01.speaker: witness
w_blackwood_gibbet_01.text: A gallows over the drinking water. There is the old kingdom entire, in one view.

w_huntsman_approach_01.speaker: witness
w_huntsman_approach_01.text: Someone has kept pace with us these three trees. A mortal, by the breathing. Be civil. He has earned his opinions.

w_huntsman_victory_01.speaker: witness
w_huntsman_victory_01.text: He was not wrong to fear what we were. Only late.

w_executioner_approach_01.speaker: witness
w_executioner_approach_01.text: Every stump a block. He has not stopped working. He has only run short of the condemned.

w_executioner_approach_03.speaker: witness
w_executioner_approach_03.text: Now he has you. Do try to be a disappointment to him.

w_executioner_victory_01.speaker: witness
w_executioner_victory_01.text: The court that passed those sentences was dissolved before your grandmother's grandmother. Nobody told the axe.

w_cathedral_approach_01.speaker: witness
w_cathedral_approach_01.text: I climbed these steps once, in a procession. I remember the incense. I do not remember what we were asking for.

w_cathedral_censer_01.speaker: witness
w_cathedral_censer_01.text: A censer that size is not for perfume. It is for covering the smell of something else.

w_widow_approach_01.speaker: witness
w_widow_approach_01.text: I know that bearing. Rebels stand straighter than kings. They have to.

w_widow_approach_03.speaker: witness
w_widow_approach_03.text: She is waiting for someone. Find out whom before you draw.

w_widow_victory_01.speaker: witness
w_widow_victory_01.text: She yielded. In my day that took more courage than dying. It still does.

w_cathedral_nave_01.speaker: witness
w_cathedral_nave_01.text: The roof came down in the Rising. I was here. No. I was told I was here. The two are not the same, and I can no longer tell them apart.

w_cathedral_choir_01.speaker: witness
w_cathedral_choir_01.text: Still singing. That hymn has forty verses. I should not stay for the last.

w_beast_approach_01.speaker: witness
w_beast_approach_01.text: Stop. Listen. What breathes under that bronze was built in a laboratory.

w_beast_victory_01.speaker: witness
w_beast_victory_01.text: A workshop under an altar. I should like to say I am surprised. I think I signed for the candles.

w_crypt_approach_01.speaker: witness
w_crypt_approach_01.text: Lamps under the water, and burning yet. Do you know, I helped consecrate this place. I cannot recall to whom.

w_crypt_ossuary_01.speaker: witness
w_crypt_ossuary_01.text: Those are for show. The dead that mattered are kept lower down, and a great deal more carefully.

w_crypt_sluice_01.speaker: witness
w_crypt_sluice_01.text: Drain it, by all means. But they flooded the lower halls on purpose. One ought always to wonder why.

w_crypt_door_01.speaker: witness
w_crypt_door_01.text: That door. I have stood before it with a ledger. Names down one column. I cannot see the heading of the other.

w_gravewarden_approach_01.speaker: witness
w_gravewarden_approach_01.text: The keeper. He is the gentlest thing down here, and he will kill you for a careless word.

w_gravewarden_approach_03.speaker: witness
w_gravewarden_approach_03.text: Ask him. He has waited long enough to be asked.

w_gravewarden_victory_01.speaker: witness
w_gravewarden_victory_01.text: He remembered their names. Every one. I was paid to remember, and I cannot manage my own.

w_roost_approach_01.speaker: witness
w_roost_approach_01.text: Glazed stone. I have seen a wall run like wax before. Never from the outside.

w_roost_mews_01.speaker: witness
w_roost_mews_01.text: They called this the Mews. One learns a great deal about a court from the things it calls small.

w_roost_chain_01.speaker: witness
w_roost_chain_01.text: A feeding lift. The cage was for cattle. Mostly.

w_roost_shells_01.speaker: witness
w_roost_shells_01.text: Numbered shells. Somebody kept a tally. Somebody always does. It was usually me.

w_wyrm_approach_01.speaker: witness
w_wyrm_approach_01.text: There she is. Veyrath. They made her to end sieges, and then they ran out of walls.

w_wyrm_approach_03.speaker: witness
w_wyrm_approach_03.text: Everything can be killed. Convincing it of that is the difficult part.

w_wyrm_victory_01.speaker: witness
w_wyrm_victory_01.text: She never once took an order. I envied her that. I believe I still do.

w_citadel_approach_01.speaker: witness
w_citadel_approach_01.text: Dressed by the right, and frozen so. Weather has no sense of drill. Somebody gave a last command here.

w_citadel_wall_01.speaker: witness
w_citadel_wall_01.text: This wall was never taken. It was closed, from within, and left.

w_rimewyrm_approach_01.speaker: witness
w_rimewyrm_approach_01.text: Something on a chain, down there. A chained thing in a king's cellar is never a pet.

w_rimewyrm_approach_03.speaker: witness
w_rimewyrm_approach_03.text: A decision he could not bring himself to make.

w_rimewyrm_victory_01.speaker: witness
w_rimewyrm_victory_01.text: It could have left at any hour. So could most of us.

w_citadel_lift_01.speaker: witness
w_citadel_lift_01.text: This cold is made, not fallen. Somewhere beneath us a great deal of effort is spent keeping one man from thawing.

w_citadel_solar_01.speaker: witness
w_citadel_solar_01.text: A queen sat at that window. I struck her name from the rolls with my own hand. I was ordered to. I think that is where I began to refuse.

w_frostking_approach_01.speaker: witness
w_frostking_approach_01.text: I knew him. He is the only one of them who ever asked to stop.

w_frostking_approach_03.speaker: witness
w_frostking_approach_03.text: Look at the door. He had to let himself.

w_frostking_victory_01.speaker: witness
w_frostking_victory_01.text: Do better than we did, he says. He always set the mark where a man might reach it.

w_deep_approach_01.speaker: witness
w_deep_approach_01.text: No. I do not know this stair. I knew every stair they built. Either this was dug afterwards, or it was taken out of me.

w_deep_names_01.speaker: witness
w_deep_names_01.text: Names, floor to roof. I cut the first of these. That was my office: to set down who a person was, before.

w_deep_stair_01.speaker: witness
w_deep_stair_01.text: Candle smoke. So this lay under your sanctuary the whole while. Your voice in the walls might have mentioned it.

w_deep_stair_03.speaker: witness
w_deep_stair_03.text: No. I do not suppose you were permitted to.

w_deep_oaths_01.speaker: witness
w_deep_oaths_01.text: They swore here to keep the stored safe. I administered the oath. It was a good oath. It deserved better men.

w_devourer_approach_01.speaker: witness
w_devourer_approach_01.text: Do not answer it, whatever it asks. It is not one voice, and not one of them is lying.

w_devourer_approach_03.speaker: witness
w_devourer_approach_03.text: The ones we lost count of. I begin to think I kept the count.

w_devourer_victory_01.speaker: witness
w_devourer_victory_01.text: Say what names you have. I will hold the rest, now that I remember how.

w_throne_approach_01.speaker: witness
w_throne_approach_01.text: The royal mile. Every face struck off. I approve the sentiment and regret the workmanship.

w_throne_hooks_01.speaker: witness
w_throne_hooks_01.text: Thirteen banners hung in this room also. Count the hooks, if you doubt me.

w_throne_crown_01.speaker: witness
w_throne_crown_01.text: There. Now I have it. They did not shut me away for what I knew. They shut me away because I would not unwrite it.

w_throne_guard_01.speaker: witness
w_throne_guard_01.text: Unrelieved. Like the first one you met. It is the same order, you know. Only the handwriting differs.

w_azhurion_approach_01.speaker: witness
w_azhurion_approach_01.text: That is the first of them. The Last Wing. Nobody wrote down how to stop it. I looked.

w_azhurion_approach_03.speaker: witness
w_azhurion_approach_03.text: The usual way. Slowly, and at great personal cost.

w_azhurion_victory_01.speaker: witness
w_azhurion_victory_01.text: The oldest thing they built, and it ends in a doorway. There is a moral in that. I decline to draw it.

w_monarch_approach_01.speaker: witness
w_monarch_approach_01.text: He will be reasonable. That is the danger of him. I served reasonable men all my life.

w_monarch_approach_03.speaker: witness
w_monarch_approach_03.text: And here I hang at your belt. What is decided in there is yours to decide. I shall only witness it.

w_monarch_victory_01.speaker: witness
w_monarch_victory_01.text: Whatever you do next, I will set it down as it happened. That much I can still swear to.

w_talk_mask_01.speaker: player
w_talk_mask_01.text: The mask. Was it your face?

w_talk_mask_02.speaker: witness
w_talk_mask_02.text: It was my office. One wore it to set down a judgment, so that the record had no face to bribe.

w_talk_mask_03.speaker: witness
w_talk_mask_03.text: It amused them, I think, to leave me in it.

w_talk_sword_01.speaker: player
w_talk_sword_01.text: This sword. They say it is enchanted.

w_talk_sword_02.speaker: witness
w_talk_sword_02.text: It is a tool nobody remembers how to make. That is all an enchantment has ever been.

w_talk_sword_03.speaker: witness
w_talk_sword_03.text: Keep it clean. It will outlast us both, and it knows it.

w_talk_lyra_01.speaker: witness
w_talk_lyra_01.text: Your Lyra says she has waited a very long time. Ask her how she knows how long.

w_talk_lyra_03.speaker: witness
w_talk_lyra_03.text: From inside? One cannot count from inside. I tried.

w_talk_lyra_04.speaker: lyra
w_talk_lyra_04.text: Then we counted differently. I had something to wait for.

w_talk_return_01.speaker: player
w_talk_return_01.text: I die, and I wake here. What does that make me?

w_talk_return_02.speaker: witness
w_talk_return_02.text: Persistent. I would not look for a grander word just yet.

w_talk_return_03.speaker: witness
w_talk_return_03.text: I watched men buy that trick with whole kingdoms. You seem to have it on loan. Mind the lender.

w_talk_smith_02.speaker: witness
w_talk_smith_02.text: Sensible. His line kept the old craft alive by trusting nobody in a mask.

w_talk_smith_03.speaker: witness
w_talk_smith_03.text: I should like him, if he would stop looking at my rivets.

w_talk_kings_01.speaker: player
w_talk_kings_01.text: Thirteen kings. Did you know them?

w_talk_kings_02.speaker: witness
w_talk_kings_02.text: I knew eleven. One died too early to matter. One I have been made to forget.

w_talk_kings_04.speaker: witness
w_talk_kings_04.text: If I could tell you that, they would have done poor work.

w_talk_people_01.speaker: lyra
w_talk_people_01.text: They were people. Every one you have cut down.

w_talk_people_02.speaker: witness
w_talk_people_02.text: They were volunteers. That is worse, and she knows it.

w_talk_people_04.speaker: witness
w_talk_people_04.text: They were. By persons like me, in rooms like this. I merely wrote it down neatly.

w_talk_silence_01.speaker: lyra
w_talk_silence_01.text: The Silence came without warning. One night the far towns simply stopped answering.

w_talk_silence_02.speaker: witness
w_talk_silence_02.text: Nothing that size comes without warning. Somebody was warned. Somebody always is, and thanked, and filed.

w_talk_silence_03.speaker: lyra
w_talk_silence_03.text: There is no record of a warning.

w_talk_silence_04.speaker: witness
w_talk_silence_04.text: No. That is rather my point about records.

w_talk_prayer_02.speaker: witness
w_talk_prayer_02.text: I attended. It is not the same. The gods sat in the front pew, taking note of who knelt.

w_talk_stored_01.speaker: lyra
w_talk_stored_01.text: The stored can be saved. All of them. I have to believe that.

w_talk_stored_02.speaker: witness
w_talk_stored_02.text: Believe it, then. I have read the ledgers. Some of those minds were filed already broken.

w_talk_stored_04.speaker: witness
w_talk_stored_04.text: No. On that, at least, we agree.

w_talk_refusal_01.speaker: witness
w_talk_refusal_01.text: It has come back, a little. There was a list. Places, and what was done in them.

w_talk_refusal_02.speaker: player
w_talk_refusal_02.text: And you were told to erase it.

w_talk_refusal_03.speaker: witness
w_talk_refusal_03.text: Seventeen times they tidied the past, and I held the pen. The eighteenth I would not.

w_talk_choice_01.speaker: player
w_talk_choice_01.text: When we reach the capital. What would you do?

w_talk_choice_02.speaker: witness
w_talk_choice_02.text: I shall not tell you. I spent a lifetime telling the powerful that what they wished for was wise.

w_talk_choice_03.speaker: witness
w_talk_choice_03.text: Choose. I will see it remembered correctly. It is the only gift I have left.

sx_cy_loose_stone_01.speaker: lyra
sx_cy_loose_stone_01.text: That one has been lifted before. Often, and carefully.

sx_cy_second_candle_01.speaker: lyra
sx_cy_second_candle_01.text: I did not light that one. I want that understood.

sx_cy_charcoal_sketch_01.speaker: lyra
sx_cy_charcoal_sketch_01.text: A drawing. Not of here. Keep it. Somebody wanted a place found again.

sx_bw_dark_lantern_01.speaker: lyra
sx_bw_dark_lantern_01.text: It was only waiting to be asked. Everything here is still waiting to be asked.

sx_bw_three_stones_01.speaker: lyra
sx_bw_three_stones_01.text: The middle one. Exactly as it was drawn. Somebody trusted a stranger to look closely.

sx_bw_woodpile_posts_01.speaker: lyra
sx_bw_woodpile_posts_01.text: The fourth one lit. They were never markers. They are the lamps for a road nobody finished.

sx_ca_end_of_cylinder_01.speaker: lyra
sx_ca_end_of_cylinder_01.text: It stopped. And then it said a number. Hymns do not end with a number.

sx_cr_whispered_name_01.speaker: lyra
sx_cr_whispered_name_01.text: It said a name. You turned your head. You turned before I had finished hearing it.

sx_ro_no_shield_01.speaker: lyra
sx_ro_no_shield_01.text: There are two footprints fused into the glass road below. Whoever made them carried no shield either. You walked down again.

sx_ci_reflection_01.speaker: lyra
sx_ci_reflection_01.text: That is a Recall surface. It is not showing you. It is playing you back.

sx_de_candle_bearer_01.speaker: witness
sx_de_candle_bearer_01.text: I know that hand. She carried it down herself, when she could still carry. Lyra, you were told you had never left the sanctuary.

sx_th_parade_sword_01.speaker: witness
sx_th_parade_sword_01.text: I was present when it was presented. The applause was the bravest thing I ever saw at court.

sx_cy_cycle_count_01.speaker: lyra
sx_cy_cycle_count_01.text: That mark was not there the first time. Or it was, and you could not see it yet. I do not know which frightens me more.

sx_th_parade_sword.title: The Parade Sword of the Ninth Jubilee
